method: Same final boards, same player perspective, current-cube units. EV differences use the same candidate cohort at every depth. Means are unweighted benchmark averages, not expected loss under natural dice frequencies. Selected-move loss is measured only where XG lists that move.
limitations: XG reference enables beavers; GNU book disables them. These are discrepancies, not pure model errors.
Finite historical XG rollouts and XGRoller++ evaluations are approximate references.
Reply 5-ply candidates are screened; neither the tree search nor this sample proves optimal play.
